implementation: Apple Secure Enclave Processor Hardware DRBG (Apple A10X)
description: Apple Secure Enclave Processor Hardware DRBG is a sub-chip cryptographic hardware implementation embedded in the Apple A10X SoC, offering various cryptographic mechanisms to Apple Secure Key Store's DRBG for tvOS 4.
